$comment: One Voice-Aware Copyedit item in a [Project]_Copyedit_Queries_[runlabel].md file. Increment 1 is queries only: `disposition` is always query and `replacement` is absent or null. `instances` hold {start_byte, end_byte, original}: UTF-8 byte offsets into the run's Manuscript_Snapshot, proven by copyedit.py E2. The id's P<paragraph> is the paragraph of the first instance. `ledger_refs` names voice-ledger entries the item touches, or `zone` names a declared zone entry's zone (the possible-voice label); `style_ref` (string or null) points at a house-style rule. The subset engine checks top-level fields; copyedit.py validates each closed instance object, provenance (E2), the ledger guard (E3) and never-flag reasons (W1). See docs/voice-aware-copyediting.md.
